[[File:YellowAjah.png|alt=The Flame of Tar Valon with yellow background.|thumb]]The table below lists all known named members of the [[Yellow Ajah]] together with information about each, mostly from [[The Wheel of Time Companion]]. It does not include the historical Amyrlins [[Catala Lucanvalle]], [[Alvera Ramosanya]] or [[Marasale Jureen]] as we have little information other than their names and tenures. 

'''Key to Columns'''

*'''Nat''': Nationality.
* '''Str''': Strength on the 72-level scale in the One Power.  > means strictly stronger than and < means strictly weaker than.
*'''Nov''': Years spent as a novice.
*'''Acc''': Years spent as Accepted.
*'''Rank''': Strength on alternative scale with 1 being the strongest Aes Sedai in the White Tower at the beginning of the series. + after the number signifies the levels above this strength.
*'''Age''': Age by the end of {{ne|1000}} or at time of death.
*'''AS''': Years wearing the shawl.
* '''Enr''': Age when entered into the novice book.
*'''Stat''': Dead (D) or Alive (A), Captured (C). Unless proven otherwise, sisters are assumed to be alive by default.
* '''Fact.''': Member of the [[Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower|Loyalist]] (L), or [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Rebel]] (R), or Unknown (U) or Neutral (N) faction of during the [[White Tower Schism]]. If blank, none of these apply.
* '''DF''': Darkfriend Yes (Y) or No (N).
*'''Bonds''': Warders or people they are bonded to or by.
*'''Notes''': Any other important information.
